balls.text: pummels off stump and waves David goodbye to finish the innings! Searing yorker, tailing into off stump. David tries to go inside-out but cannot get under it. Misses the ball completely and sees his off stump lying flat on the deck moments later. Prasidh gives David a bit of a goodbye, but this is another handy cameo, and RCB have more than a handy total on the board!
four more! David is taking RCB closer to 170! Short on leg stump and that is not great bowling with no fine leg in place. David gets a bit of bat on it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence!

that is a bruising blow, and that has landed ten rows back over long off! Short outside off and with David ready for it, that was always asking for trouble. He sets himself up and forehands it. That is some shot!
streaky but guess what, they all count! Banged into the track outside off. David swings like a rusty gate and gets an inside edge that flashes past the stumps and then bounces up past Buttler!

shanked high into the night sky, and it lands safely! Back of a length just outside off. David has an ungainly swipe it and skies it. Sai Kishore calls for it (from mid wicket) but cannot get to it with the ball falling in the mid on region

hard length on middle and leg. Skips off the surface and that rushes David on the pull. He splices it towards deep mid wicket and they opt against the single, despite Bhuvneshwar almost running two by himself. Perhaps the right call
bumper to finish the over. Gets up to the shoulder and David rolls his wrists to pull it towards deep backward square leg. Keeps strike too
sharp bumper, pitching outside off and decking back in. David, cramped for room, opts to sway out of the way in the end
angled in full on leg stump. Bhuvneshwar cannot get under it and clinks it towards long on
slanted in full on middle and off. Bhuvneshwar comes half forward and prods it back to the bowler
full ball sliding down leg. Bhuvneshwar does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

nicked and gone! Livingstone falls, moments after getting to his fifty! Short, wide and there to be hit. Livingstone throws the kitchen sink at it and only manages a faint tickle through to Buttler. Buttler finally holds onto one, and Siraj, on his return to the Chinnaswamy, has a three-wicket haul!
full toss on middle and off. David is taken aback a little and shanks it to the left of the pitch. Siraj tears after it, slides and fields it on his follow-through

six more - Livingstone is ripping Rashid to shreds! Floated up but right into the slot on off. Livingstone unleashes that sweep and bulldozes it over deep square leg. Brings up his fifty too and this has been a superb knock under pressure!
no one can catch that, apart from those in the crowd! Given a bit of air, on a full length on leg stump. Livingstone drops down to one knee early and mauls it over deep backward square leg!
full outside off. David lunges forward and pokes it into the point region for a single
darted in full on leg stump. Livingstone tucks it off his toes for a single

bursts through the hands! Low full toss just outside leg. Livingstone brings out the sweep again and tugs it towards deep backward square leg. Sai Kishore leaps into the air but cannot clasp his hands around it. He was well inside the fence too!

GT appeal and appeal and appeal, but the umpire is unmoved! GT cannot review either! Googly on a full length on middle and off. Livingstone swipes across the line and gets hit on the abdomen region while being down on one knee. Seemed pretty good but GT can do nothing about it!
peach to end his spell! Fizzed in on a length just outside off. Drifts in and then grips in the surface to rip away. Well past the outside edge and David nods in appreciation
back of a length wide outside off. Left alone by David and called a wide. Seemed touch-and-go but leaning more towards being a wide
slow and short outside off. Livingstone sits deep in his crease and cuts it towards deep cover
shortish outside off. David hangs back and slaps it towards long off
David in on the six-hitting act now! A bit of a drag-down, just outside off. David opens up his stance and muscles it over the shorter deep mid wicket fence!
slower on a length just outside off. Livingstone pokes it towards backward point and calls his partner through for the single
back of a length outside off. Livingstone waits in his crease and plays with the turn towards backward point
googly on a back of a length just outside off. David hangs back and defends
edged and four! On the shorter side again, and also offering width. David throws his hands at it and the ball flies off the outside edge past slip!
back of a length on the stumps. Livingstone glances it towards short fine leg

excellent effort by Siraj! Fuller outside off. Livingstone gets down on one knee and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket. Siraj prioritizes the catch and even though he does not get there, he gets his body behind it to save two

clears the fence, just! And Livingstone breaks the shackles! Another half-tracker outside off. Livingstone opens up his stance and pummels it just over Siraj at deep mid wicket! That was bowled from well behind the crease too!
dragged down outside off. David hops back and cuts it powerfully towards sweeper cover
fuller outside off. Livingstone opens his bat face and guides it towards backward point
tossed up on a length outside off. Livingstone stretches forward and drops it into the off side with soft hands
shorter outside off. Keeps a touch low and David, hanging back, slaps it past extra cover for a single
fizzed in on a back of a length on off. Grips in the surface again and spins away, squaring up David, who prods it off the back foot into the off side

that is probably the softest dismissal you will see all season! Back of a length just outside off and this seems to be a change-up. Goes the other way after pitching and also holds a touch. Krunal is bamboozled by it and gets a tame leading edge as he tries to work to leg. Sai Kishore completes the easiest of catches, and the Titans have wicket number six!
hung up on a back of a length wide outside off. Livingstone reaches out for it and cuts it towards sweeper cover
loose ball and punished by Krunal! Too full and too far down leg. Krunal brings out the sweep and helps it away to the fine leg fence!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Livingstone reads it off the pitch and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
googly on a back of a length, finishing just outside off. Krunal knocks it to long on to get off the mark
darted in full on the stumps. Livingstone gets to the pitch of the ball and works it towards deep mid wicket. Call is for two initially but they decide against it in the end

was that a stumping chance?! Floated up very full outside off. Livingstone plays all over it and his back foot gets dragged out. Buttler, however, does not gather. He has not been at his best behind the stumps tonight
fired in very full on leg stump, perhaps trying to bowl Livingstone around his legs. Having walked across, he sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
quicker, flatter and shorter outside off. Krunal goes back and pokes it towards extra cover
flighted up full outside off. Krunal presses half forward and defends it towards the bowler

goes a mile up again and this time, Tewatia holds on! Jitesh falls for 33 and a promising partnership is broken! Sai Kishore gives it a bit of air but also makes a point to hold his length ball. That invites Jitesh to charge and swing for the hills. But because he is not to the pitch of the ball, he clinks it off the toe-end. Tewatia runs in from long on, keeps his eyes on the ball and ensures it stays in his grasp. Big wicket in the context of the game, and Jitesh is distraught as he walks back!
back of a length on middle and leg. Livingstone has a massive hack across the line and jams it off the inside edge into his back leg. Rolls away towards short third for a single
just short again! Tossed up full just outside leg. Jitesh, after shimmying around, gets down on the sweep and hits it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
full and wide outside off. Livingstone gets down on the paddle-sweep and helps it behind square for a single
Jitesh wants a piece of Rashid too! Darted in on a length on off. Jitesh gets down on one knee this time and helps it over short fine leg!
full on middle and off, trying to trap Livingstone in front. Having moved across his stumps, he flicks it towards deep mid wicket
fired in quicker, on a full length on middle and off. Livingstone prods it into the off side
Livingstone takes Rashid on! Tossed up full just outside off. Livingstone shuffles across early, gets down on one knee and wallops it over deep square leg!
googly on a length outside off. Livingstone lunges forward and defends

Rashid pleads and pleads and pleads, but the umpire says no! GT review! Googly on a length outside off. Grips in the surface and spins back sharply. Livingstone is beaten on the slog-sweep and gets pinged on the body. Was the impact outside off, was it too high? Well, let's find out. No bat involved but Ball Tracking returns with Umpire's Call on Impact, with the ball also going over off stump. GT out of reviews now!
insult to injury! A different batter but it will hurt just as much. Full outside off, allowing Jitesh to get his hands through the ball and he bludgeons it over extra cover!

goes a mile up, and oh, this is going to bring down rain! Dropped by Tewatia as well, and that could be a big moment in the game! Floated up on middle and leg, and Livingstone is beaten in the air completely. Has to reach out well in front, despite advancing and he launches it a mile up. Tewatia settles under it at long on and makes a complete mess of it
back of a length on off. Holds a little in the surface and Livingstone prods it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Livingstone makes room and then hacks at it, chunking it off the inside edge into his back leg
short of the fielder! Back of a length on middle and leg. Skids onto Jitesh and he splices his pull. Fortunately for him, it does not carry to deep mid wicket
short outside off. Livingstone backs away and slaps it towards sweeper cover
banged into the track outside off and this skips off the surface. Jitesh, backing away to crash it over point, only swishes at thin air
full and wide outside off. Livingstone presses forward and drives it towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Jitesh uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
shortish outside off. Livingstone waits in his crease and drops it into the off side. Has to scramble and puts in the dive to complete the single. A direct hit would have made things interesting

how has he gotten that away?! Brutish short ball that pitches outside off and decks back in sharply. Livingstone is almost trying to drop his hands but the ball rushes onto him, kisses the glove (or the shoulder of the bat) and flies over Buttler's head!
hard length on middle and off. Livingstone hops up onto his toes and taps it towards mid wicket

scorched away, and the crowd has firmly found its voice now! Ishant makes the mistake of banging it half-way down and offering ample width. Jitesh snaps those fast hands into action and scythes it to backward point's left!
length outside off. Jitesh gets onto the front foot confidently and pushes it towards extra cover
short, wide and punished! Jitesh is turning it on now! Too much width on offer and Jitesh gets on top of the bounce nicely to knife it past backward point!
length outside off. Jitesh gets onto the front foot and hacks it past mid wicket for a couple of runs. Looks like Jitesh wants to counter-attack
bam! Jitesh goes big! Right in the slot on middle and off. Jitesh plants his front foot, brings his wrists into play and shovels it over long on!
the bat flies off and the ball rolls down to deep third! Back of a length outside off. Livingstone throws his bat at it (quite literally) and guides it behind point for a single
hard length just outside off, nipping back in to cramp the batter for room. Jitesh drops it into the off side
full outside off. Jitesh gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
shortish just outside off. Jitesh gets up on his toes and pats it towards backward point. 144.1kph that, and Prasidh is working up some good pace

oh my! Full and wide outside off. Jitesh looks to lap it away but does not get any purchase out of it. Scuffs it towards backward point. Got into an awkward position too, with no room to get under the ball
back of a length in the channel. Whizzes off the surface, while moving away marginally and that takes it past the outside edge of Jitesh's bat
back of a length outside off. Livingstone skips down the track and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Jitesh uses the pace, opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third for a brace
Jitesh is off the mark with a boundary! Ishant goes short on middle and off, and Jitesh is waiting for it. He swivels inside the line and hooks it fine for four!
back of a length outside off. Jitesh hangs back and taps it towards backward point
well well! Back of a length wide outside off. Jitesh looks for the sweep first up and then decides to bail out of it at the last moment. Interesting choice of shot...

Ishant goes up in appeal, and the finger goes up too! Ishant has a wicket in his first over! And Patidar does not bother with the review either! On a length, slanting back into Patidar from off stump. He has a hack across the line and perhaps aims too square. Gets smashed on the back leg in front of middle and leg, and the slow, dreaded finger sends RCB's skipper back on his way. Ball Tracking confirms the ball would have thundered into middle and leg. RCB are four down now, and tottering!
take that, says Rajat Patidar! Half-volley on middle and leg. Patidar gives himself a bit of room and then blasts it to mid off's left!
safe again! Shortish, angling into the hips. Patidar looks for the pick-up pull but the ball hurries onto him quite a bit. Scuffs it and the ball lands in the vacant short fine leg region
another proper jaffa! Back of a length in that testing corridor just outside off. Patidar plays for the ball coming in but it straightens just enough to rip past the outside edge
back of a length outside off and the ball is flying off the pitch now. Patidar has a swipe of his own but the ball whistles past his flailing blade
back of a length on leg stump. Livingstone is late on the flick and the ball bobbles off the thigh pad towards long leg
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this nibbles away late as well. Livingstone is opened up like a deck chair and beaten comprehensively
safe! Back of a length on off. Moves away a touch and that squares up Patidar. Gets a leading edge but luckily for him, it lands just in front of cover point
into the blockhole just outside off. Livingstone jams down on it and digs it out towards mid off

massive lbw appeal, not given! Back of a length in the channel and this decks back sharply, while also keeping a little low. Livingstone seems to play all around it and gets pinged on the back thigh. Height could be an issue, but Siraj and GT want to take another look. Clear gap between bat and ball. Onto Ball Tracking now. It comes up and...reckons the ball would have bounced comfortably over the stumps. Excellent decision by umpire Ulhas Gandhe, and Livingstone stays!

off stump goes for a toss, and you can now hear a pin drop at the Chinnaswamy! Talk about a perfect response. Smashed onto the road last ball, and now demolishing Salt's stumps like there is no tomorrow. Fullish ball, starting on middle and off and curving away. Salt tries to hit it into next week and only swats away a few flies. Sees his stumps in an absolute mess soon after, and Buttler, more than anyone else, will heave a huge sigh of relief!

pick the bones out of that one! Banged into the track on middle and off, and Salt is waiting for this. Bowled at 143.6 but because Salt has telegraphed it, he opens up his stance early and whacks it a 105m over cow corner. Lands on the roof, and that is outta here!
back of a length just outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and nudges it towards mid on

mix-up and had Siraj hit, Salt would have been on his way! Hard length just outside off. Salt hacks at it and jams it off the inside edge into his body. Salt gets called through for the run and Siraj, after gathering on his follow-through, cannot hit the stumps at the bowler's end. That was bowled at 143.4kph
full toss swinging into the pads. Salt tugs it towards deep backward square leg and retains strike
Salt finally comes to the party! Back of a length outside off. There is width to work with and Salt rises with the bounce to thrash it on the up past extra cover!
fullish on middle and leg. Patidar flicks it to mid on and saunters across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Patidar waits in his crease and meets the ball right under his eyes
Patidar goes up and over! Arshad goes searching and bowls it into Patidar's arc on middle and off. He stands up tall and smacks it over mid wicket!
full and swinging again, but this swings down leg because of how close it started to leg stump. Patidar does not get bat on it and the umpire has to indulge in some exercise
back of a length on the hips. Skids onto Salt again and he is late on the flick. The ball trickles off the thigh pad into the on side
back of a length just outside off. Salt punches it towards mid on and dashes across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Salt presses half forward and stabs it towards mid off

massive lbw shout, not given by umpire Ulhas Gandhe! Speared in full on middle and leg. Patidar falls across a little and then plays all around it. Gets rapped on the pads but that was probably heading down. Good decision by the umpire
back of a length outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and jabs it straight to cover point

zing bails everywhere, and Siraj is back to haunt his former team! Back of a length, pitching on middle and leg and zipping off the surface. Nips away with the angle slightly and Padikkal, advancing and trying to smash it over the off side, only connects with fresh air. Off stump knocked back, and Siraj is over the moon. RCB lose two inside three overs!
back of a length, angling into off. Salt gets down on one knee, looking to sweep it away and gets pinged on the body. Gets a leg bye for his troubles
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal gets behind the line and pats it gently towards mid on
sloppy in the ring, and Padikkal is off the mark! Length outside off. Padikkal gets forward, gets on top of the bounce and drives it towards cover point, who dives over it and lets in four!

straight to long leg, and Prasidh Krishna makes no mistake! Now we know why Arshad was brought in tonight! Shortish on leg stump and this is there for Kohli to play the pick-up pull. He does not display enough conviction, though, neither keeping it down nor trying to clear the fence completely. Tugs it to the fielder, and that is proper catching practice. Arshad looks up to the heavens in delight, and there is stunned silence at the Chinnaswamy!
in-swinging yorker on off. Kohli spots it in time, jams his bat down and digs it out towards the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Sticks a little in the surface and plonks it towards mid wicket
full and swinging into the pads. Kohli rolls his wrists and glances it towards long leg for a couple of runs
shortish just outside off. Skids off the surface and hustles onto Salt, who cloths his pull towards mid on. That was bowled at 140.4kph

was that a chance?! Dug into the track on middle and leg, after seeing Salt advance. He has a massive swish at it and seems to nick it through. Buttler, though, puts down an absolute sitter. Hit him in the midriff in the end
shortish outside off. Salt throws his hands at it and jabs it towards cover point
back of a length just outside off. Kohli gets up on his toes and dabs it towards short third

off the mark in pristine style! And the Chinnaswamy has something to cheer about very early! Length outside off, shaping away nicely. Kohli's shot, though, is just too good. Stays on top of the bounce and cracks it past extra cover!
safe! Sharp short ball, angling into middle and leg. Salt is cramped for room and splices his pull. Hangs agonizingly in the air and lands safely in the backward square leg region

Rutherford lands the final blow! And the Gujarat Titans have done this at a canter in the end! A comprehensive eight-wicket win, inside 18 overs and RCB's record has a blemish - that too in front of their adoring fans! Fractionally short on leg stump and that is enough for Rutherford. Swivels beautifully and dumps it over the long leg fence. Easy as you like, and the Titans, who were chastened in their opening game, have now won two on the spin!
another short ball outside off. Buttler winds up for the good'ol heave across the line but this time, chalks it off the toe-end towards deep third. Well, he is human

that has gone a country mile, and Buttler is revving up the engine of the tuk-tuk! Banged into the track outside off. Buttler knows that is coming and sets up deep inside his crease. Clatters it over deep mid wicket and RCB hearts sink further!

Buttler showing off his repertoire now! Back of a length just outside off. Buttler shapes up for the reverse ramp and nails it to perfection. Straight over the keeper's head. Audacious is the word to describe that!
back of a length outside off. Rutherford waits on it and guides it down to deep third
back of a length just outside off. Rutherford dangles his bat at it and jams it off the inside edge. The ball rolls off his pads towards backward point, allowing a single
taxi, where are you?! Haul that ball back, please! Shortish on the hips and Rutherford will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Steps inside the line and pummels it over long leg!
back of a length just outside off. Rutherford presses half forward and taps it towards backward point. Another dot...
back of a length on off. Buttler gets up on his toes and stabs it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Sticks in the surface and that meddles with Buttler's timing on the back-foot punch. Scuffed back to the bowler
shortish on leg stump. Rutherford picks it up and tugs it on the bounce to deep mid wicket

dispatched to the fence, and GT, more or less, get what they needed from this over! Slower ball straying onto the pads. Buttler's eyes light up and he whips it behind square, beating short fine leg to his left comfortably. Seven off the over, when the required run-rate was 7.2 and GT are coasting!
back of a length outside off. Rutherford meets the ball very late and with soft hands, gliding it towards short third for a single
back of a length outside off. Stops in the surface and Rutherford punches it towards mid off
safe! Angled in and following the batter outside leg. Buttler's bottom hand comes off as he swings at this and drags it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
hard length just outside off. Nips back in, cramps Buttler up and he prods it back towards the bowler
fullish outside off. Rutherford gets onto the front foot and drives on the up towards deep point

follows up the four with a sumptuous maximum! Given plenty of air and this lands in the slot again, on leg stump. Buttler gets his front foot out of the way and clubs it over long on. Brings up his fifty too - a sensational knock, hunting a tricky total on a tricky track!
clean as a whistle! Leg-spinner looped up into the slot just outside off. Buttler tees it up, goes through the line and bangs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on off. Rutherford stays leg side of the ball and pushes it towards extra cover
RCB appeal, but no review! Darted in on a length on leg stump. Rutherford has a huge swing at it and misses. The ball kisses his body and is then caught by Jitesh, leading to the caught-behind appeal
shortish just outside off. Rutherford hops back and cuts it nicely but straight to backward point
back of a length outside leg. Buttler goes back and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
high and handsome from Rutherford! Floated up into the slot on leg stump, and Rutherford goes absolutely massive. Free swing through the line and he tonks this 91m over long on!
length on middle and off. Spins away a little and Buttler punches it down the ground towards long off
tossed up full on middle and off. Rutherford comes forward and eases it to long on
short again, wide outside off. Buttler hangs back and cuts it towards deep point
short on off. Rutherford opens up his stance and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
fullish just outside off. Buttler presses half forward and knocks it to long off
off the mark in style! Short outside off and Rutherford, sitting deep in his crease, throws his hands at it, flaying it past backward point for four!
back of a length in and around off. Rutherford gets behind the line and defends
back of a length just outside off. Rutherford lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes

Sudharsan gets the lap-shot wrong, and Hazlewood breaks through! On a length outside off and Sudharsan, for some reason, tries the lap. Not sure that was the best option, given Hazlewood had been brought back just to take a wicket. Makes a mess of the stroke and scuffs it, offering Jitesh a simple enough catch moving to his right. Vital wicket for RCB, and they have a window of opportunity now!
back of a length outside off. Buttler waits for it and runs it down to deep third
hard length on leg stump. Sudharsan skips down the track and turns it past mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Sudharsan hangs back and works it towards deep mid wicket

this is a misfield, and uncharacteristically sloppy work from Kohli! Tossed up on a length on the stumps. Sudharsan gets down on one knee and hits it like a bullet to Kohli at deep mid wicket. Pitches on the half-volley and it bursts through Kohli. He might have hurt his hand too, and the entire ground and thousands of RCB fans take a collective breath!

did Kohli misjudge that?! Shortish on middle and leg. Sudharsan rocks into position and mauls it to deep mid wicket's right. Kohli was back-tracking, which made it feel like he misjudged it but it wsa placed well by the batter!
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler goes back and turns it towards deep mid wicket
Buttler parks it into the stands again! Slanted into the slot on leg stump and Krunal gets met! Buttler gets his front foot out of the way and smokes it over cow corner!
very full on leg stump. Driven down the ground to long on
oh, that almost carried! Back of a length on middle and leg. Stops a touch in the surface and Buttler nearly pops it straight back to Dayal
shortish outside off. Sudharsan hangs back deep in his crease and cuts it towards deep point
shortens the length just outside leg after seeing Buttler advance. He adjusts and punches it to mid off for a single
width offered, and pounced upon by Jos Buttler! A little on the shorter side too, meaning Buttler can sit deep in his crease and carve it between backward point and short third!
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler presses half forward and taps it gently towards mid wicket
hard length on leg stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Skids on low and Sudharsan, trying the short-arm-pull, squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
angled in on a length on the pads. Buttler does not get bat on it and the ball kisses his back leg, trickling towards short fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan hangs back and cuts it towards backward point, who misfields slightly and allows a single
splits the field! Dragged down a little outside off and that is all Sudharsan needs. He rocks back and places it right between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
zipped in full just outside off. Sudharsan looks for the reverse but only swats away a few flies in the process. Sharp work by Jitesh to take off the bails too
fired in full on leg stump. Buttler tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
pushed in on a back of a length on off. Buttler eases it to long on and retains strike
watch out in the crowd! Another short ball on the stumps and Buttler reads this like the morning daily. Stands up tall and pounds it over deep backward square leg!
shortish on middle and leg. Buttler gives himself a bit of room and cuts it powerfully. Straight to backward point, though

miscue, but it carries all the way! Not exactly where Buttler was intending. This was on a back of a length outside off and Buttler swung wildly at it. Got a top edge and that was enough to take it over the deep third fence!
the big shot comes, and Buttler helps himself to four! Dug into the track on off. Buttler skips down the track and smears it past mid wicket!
shortish outside off. Sudharsan waits on it and cuts it neatly towards deep point
back of a length, angling across just outside off. Buttler gets behind the line and defends
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan drops it into the off side and canters across to the other end
dug into the track outside off. Sudharsan hops up onto his toes and cuts it towards backward point

length ball hung up wide outside off. Sudharsan goes chasing at it without any real conviction and sees the ball nibble past the outside edge. He was probably playing for the ball coming in but it just held its line

short, wide and put away! That is one of Sudharsan's stronger areas and he makes Dayal pay. Jumps up onto his toes and scythes it past backward point. Livingstone got his right hand to it but that was not enough!
almost! Back of a length outside off, bowled at 133.9kph and this decks back sharply. Cuts Sudharsan in half as he jabs at it and that was very close to off stump!
tickled away to the fence! Back of a length on off. Buttler walks down the track and also goes across his stumps. Gets the faintest of touches to beat Jitesh to his left!
shortish outside off. Sudharsan uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
dispatched! Half-tracker outside off and this is just begging to be hit. Sudharsan obliges and hammers it through mid wicket!
shorter outside off. Buttler advances, stands up on his toes and punches it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Buttler gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands
hard length just outside off. Buttler goes walkabouts and then tries to work to leg. Misses it completely and gets pinged on the front thigh. Well outside the line, though
back of a length on leg stump. GT's game of tip and run continues and this time, Buttler places it just past the bowler to retain strike
full outside off. Sudharsan gets forward and flicks it enough to mid on's right to bag another single
oh! Back of a length on middle and off. Sticks in the surface and moves away, squaring up Buttler. He gets a leading edge but the ball dribbles away between short extra cover and cover point
back of a length on off. Sudharsan drops it into the off side and looks at Buttler, who responds and saunters across
what timing! Drifts onto the pads and pays the price. Sudharsan uses the angle and snaps his wrists into action, clipping it beautifully behind square!
full outside off. Buttler drives it neatly towards mid off and calls for the single. Puts on his skates to get there. Reckon he timed that much better than he thought he did
back of a length outside off. Buttler opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
angled in on a back of a length on off. Buttler gets behind the line and defends

in the air and taken by Livingstone! Gill falls after a six, and the Chinnaswamy finds its voice! Length outside off and Gill looks to repeat the dose. Tries to go over mid off this time but cuts across it too much. Skews off the outer half of the bat and Livingstone, tearing in from deep backward point, makes no mistake at all diving forward. Massive moment in the game!
does not even look to see where that has gone - because Gill knows it has travelled miles! Slot ball outside off. Gill plants his front foot, swings through the line and launches it over long on!
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill lets the ball come to him before turning it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Gill gets behind the line and defends
hard length on middle and off. Zips off the surface and hurries onto Sudharsan, who chunks it off the inside edge into his back thigh
this is an even better shot - wow! Full just outside off. Sudharsan marches down the track, shows the maker's name and crrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhhhessssss it back past the bowler!
shot - that is one way to break free! Back of a length outside off. Sudharsan pre-empts the line, shuffles across and laps it cleanly over the keeper's head!
angled in on a length on off. Gill drops it into the off side and calls for the single early. Has to hustle but makes it comfortably enough in the end
back of a length outside off and this leaves the batter late. Gill goes wafting at it without any footwork and gets beaten on the outside
fullish outside off. Gill looks to go downtown but shanks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid on
back of a length on leg stump. Skids off the surface and Sudharsan is late on the flick. The ball thuds into his thigh pad and rolls into the on side
back of a length outside off. Gill hangs back and guides it towards deep backward point
shortens the length after seeing Gill advance. He waits for the ball and pats it gently into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Kicks up on Sudharsan and he glances it slightly uppishly towards fine leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill bunts it to mid on and hurtles across to the other end. Sharp running
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan plays it late and with an open bat face, dabbing it towards deep third
up and over, and Gill lands his first blow! Goes searching a little and hangs it up full outside off. Gill goes after it and crashes it over point!
back of a length outside off. Gill hangs back and stabs it towards mid off
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill gets behind the line and taps it towards mid wicket
shortish just outside off. Sudharsan tips it to mid on and hares across to the other end
short and wide outside off again. Keeps a little low and squirms under Sudharsan's flailing blade. Called a wide, though
hard length just outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
short outside off and this climbs through after pitching. Sudharsan has a huge swish at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air. David felt the ball grazed the bat but no real support from elsewhere
back of a length on leg stump. Sudharsan is a touch late on the flick and the ball trickles off the thigh pad behind square
back of a length on the hips. Sudharsan tucks it away towards deep backward square leg and dashes back for two
what a ball! Length in the channel and this swerves back in devilishly. Sudharsan, looking to defend, is cut in half
back of a length just outside off. Gill accounts for the outward swing and drops it into the off side with soft hands
shorter on leg stump. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and helps it down to fine leg. Given as leg byes, though
length ball that starts just outside off and shapes back in. Sudharsan, having taken a step down the track, pokes it towards the bowler
